```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Observed species richness

This fundamental indicator quantifies the total number of unique species per year detected in Natura 2000 versus non Natura 2000 area. It provides a straightforward measure of detected biodiversity.

**Not corrected for surface area**

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
OSR_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/OSR_ts.rds')


OSR_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/OSR_ts.rds')

# stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets
df_nat     <- as.data.frame(OSR_ts_Natura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "Natura2000")
df_non     <- as.data.frame(OSR_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, size = 1) +   # gesmoothte lijn per groep
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +             # ruwe data in dezelfde kleur
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Observed species richness",
       colour = "") +
  theme_minimal() 


```

**Corrected for surface area**

```{r}
area_nat <- 4267
area_non <- 10105

df_nat <- df_nat%>%
  mutate(richness_adj = diversity_val / area_nat)

df_non <- df_non%>%
  mutate(richness_adj = diversity_val / area_non)

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = richness_adj, colour = Group)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Observed species richness (per km²)",
       colour = "") +
  theme_minimal()
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Total Occurrences

This variable quantifies the overall number of species occurrence records per year in Natura2000 versus nonNatura2000 area. While not a biodiversity indicator itself, it is crucial for understanding data comprehensiveness and distribution. It is presented as a map showing data density or a time series of annual record counts.

**Not corrected for surface area**

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
TO_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/TO_ts.rds')


TO_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/TO_ts.rds')

# stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets
df_nat     <- as.data.frame(TO_ts_Natura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "Natura2000")
df_non     <- as.data.frame(TO_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group, fill = Group)) +

  # groeps-trend
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, alpha= 0.15) +

  # ruwe punten
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  # 👇 individuele bars rond elk punt
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ll, ymax = ul),
    width = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 0.6
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total occurences",
    colour = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )+
  theme_minimal() 
```

**Corrected for surface area**

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
area_nat <- 4267
area_non <- 10105

df_nat <- df_nat %>%
  mutate(
    occurrences_adj = diversity_val / area_nat,
    ll_adj = ll / area_nat,
    ul_adj = ul / area_nat
  )

df_non <- df_non %>%
  mutate(
    occurrences_adj = diversity_val / area_non,
    ll_adj = ll / area_non,
    ul_adj = ul / area_non
  )

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both,
       aes(x = year,
           y = occurrences_adj,
           colour = Group,
           fill = Group)) +

  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.15) +

  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ll_adj, ymax = ul_adj),
    width = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.7,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total occurrences per km²",
    colour = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Occurrence Density

Occurrence Density measures the spatial concentration of records by calculating the total number of occurrences per square kilometre. This allows for more meaningful comparisons between spatial units of different sizes.

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
OD_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/OD_ts.rds')


OD_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/OD_ts.rds')

# stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets
df_nat     <- as.data.frame(OD_ts_Natura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "Natura2000")
df_non     <- as.data.frame(OD_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group, fill = Group)) +

  # groeps-trend
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, alpha= 0.15) +

  # ruwe punten
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  # 👇 individuele bars rond elk punt
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ll, ymax = ul),
    width = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 0.6
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Occurence density",
    colour = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )+
  theme_minimal() 
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Rarity

Rarity quantifies the scarcity or infrequency of species, and when summed over multiple species, serves as a crucial biodiversity indicator for conservation. b3gbi offers two distinct measures: Abundance-Based Rarity (based on species' proportional occurrences) and Area-Based Rarity (based on species' spatial occupancy). These can be mapped (indicator_map) to identify areas with a higher presence of rare species, or tracked over time (indicator_ts) to observe changes in overall rarity.

### Abundance - Based Rarity

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
AbRM_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/AbRM_ts.rds')


AbRM_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/AbRM_ts.rds')

# stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets

df_non     <- as.data.frame(AbRM_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group, fill = Group)) +

  # groeps-trend
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, alpha= 0.15) +

  # ruwe punten
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  # 👇 individuele bars rond elk punt
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ll, ymax = ul),
    width = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 0.6
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Abundance - Based Rarity",
    colour = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )+
  theme_minimal() 
```

## Estimated Hill Diversity

Hill Diversity provides a unified framework for various diversity measures, allowing for different emphases on rare versus common species through a single parameter, q. b3gbi calculates three common forms: q=0 (approximates Species Richness, weighing all species equally), q=1 (emphasizes common species, like Hill-Shannon), and q=2 (emphasizes very common species, like Hill-Simpson). These indicators represent the "effective number of species" and can be mapped (indicator_map) or tracked over time (indicator_ts) to provide multi-faceted insights into biodiversity patterns.

### Species richness (q=0)

```{r, eval=FALSE, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
SR_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/SR_ts.rds')


SR_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/SR_ts.rds')

 stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets
df_nat     <- as.data.frame(SR_ts_Natura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "Natura2000")
df_non     <- as.data.frame(SR_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group, fill = Group)) +

  # groeps-trend
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, alpha= 0.15) +

  # ruwe punten
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  # individuele bars rond elk punt
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = ll, ymax = ul),
    width = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.7,
    size = 0.6
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Species richness",
    colour = "",
    fill = ""
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )+
  theme_minimal() 
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group, fill = Group)) +

  # groeps-trend
  geom_smooth(se = TRUE, size = 1, alpha= 0.15) +

  # ruwe punten
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

  # 👇 individuele bars rond elk punt

  ) +

```

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Cumulative Species Richness

This indicator tracks the total number of unique species observed from the beginning of a specified time period up to a given year. It provides an estimation of how many new species are still being recorded over time within a region, helping to evaluate sampling effort and assess the overall recorded biodiversity over the study duration. This is an inherently temporal indicator, presented as a time series (indicator_ts).

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
CR_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/CR_ts.rds')


CR_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/CR_ts.rds')

# stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets
df_nat     <- as.data.frame(CR_ts_Natura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "Natura2000")
df_non     <- as.data.frame(CR_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, size = 1) +   # gesmoothte lijn per groep
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +             # ruwe data in dezelfde kleur
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Cumulative species richness",
       colour = "") +
  theme_minimal() 
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Mean Year of Occurrence (Newness)

This variable calculates the average year of occurrence for all records within a given spatial unit (e.g., grid cell, for indicator_map) or temporal unit (e.g., year, for indicator_ts), providing an estimation of the relative recency of observations. Maps can highlight areas with more recent average records, while time series show the average observation date over cumulative data.

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
NN_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/NN_ts.rds')


NN_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/NN_ts.rds')

# stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets
df_nat     <- as.data.frame(NN_ts_Natura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "Natura2000")
df_non     <- as.data.frame(NN_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, size = 1) +   # gesmoothte lijn per groep
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +             # ruwe data in dezelfde kleur
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Newness (Mean Year of Occurence)",
       colour = "") +
  theme_minimal() 
```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Occupancy turnover

Occupancy Turnover measures the rate at which occupancy composition changes over time within a community, quantifying the balance between species "gains" and "losses" between consecutive time intervals. High turnover indicates a dynamic community with frequent species replacement, while low turnover suggests stability. This is an exclusively temporal indicator, presented as a time series (indicator_ts).

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE,message = FALSE}
OT_ts_Natura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_Natura2000/OT_ts.rds')


OT_ts_nonNatura2000 <- readRDS('./Insecta_data_Flanders_nonNatura2000/OT_ts.rds')

# stel: ts_nat en ts_non zijn output van indicator_ts voor twee subsets
df_nat     <- as.data.frame(OT_ts_Natura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "Natura2000")
df_non     <- as.data.frame(OT_ts_nonNatura2000$data) %>% mutate(Group = "nonNatura2000")

df_both <- bind_rows(df_nat, df_non)

ggplot(df_both, aes(x = year, y = diversity_val, colour = Group)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE, size = 1) +   # gesmoothte lijn per groep
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +             # ruwe data in dezelfde kleur
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Occupancy turnover",
       colour = "") +
  theme_minimal() 
```
:::
